# The Joneses — The Smiths Tribute Band

> The Joneses are a five-piece Smiths tribute band formed in October 2016, based in London and the South East and performing live across the UK and Europe.

Two guitarists let the band recreate Johnny Marr's layered guitar parts, including the Craig Gannon era. Live shows feature a theatrical Morrissey-style frontman, flowers, and audience singalongs, plus occasional covers of The Cure, Echo and the Bunnymen, Talking Heads and Depeche Mode.

The band are available for private events, festivals and venue bookings across the UK and Europe.

- [Book The Joneses](https://www.thejonesesband.co.uk/book-the-joneses/): Booking information for private events, festivals and venues.
